summary: Sample the caller's fixed equilibrium psi and selected local profile fields at explicitly requested R-Z points; the flux_loops key retains psi units and unrequested keys are absent.

identity.relation: declared equilibrium fields and diagnostic point requests to sampled predictions
identity.direction: equilibrium, R-Z grid and observation requests -> optional flux_loops and thomson predictions
identity.definition: For a flux_loops request, bilinearly sample equilibrium.psi at its points without converting to complete loop flux. For a thomson request, separately sample equilibrium.profiles.p_parallel and p_perp and any present non-null density and electron_temperature at its points. Assemble only requested diagnostic keys, with no measurement or instrument response model.
identity.model: read-only point projection of supplied equilibrium fields using the bound bilinear R-Z sampler
identity.geometry: two-dimensional rectilinear cylindrical R-Z diagnostic grid supplied by the caller
identity.coordinates: fields and grids are indexed [Z,R]; every diagnostic point is ordered [R,Z]
identity.boundary: The bound sampler accepts points on the closed grid boundary and rejects out-of-domain points; no extrapolation is performed.
assumptions: All sampled fields correspond to the same caller-supplied R-Z grid.

The caller supplies physically meaningful fields and mutually consistent units; this graph does not infer or convert them. In particular, psi=R A_phi from current SciRel free-boundary equilibrium is Wb/rad, whereas a complete axisymmetric circular-loop flux is 2π psi in Wb.

inputs.name: equilibrium
inputs.description: Read-only state mapping; flux_loops requires a non-null psi field, and thomson requires a profiles mapping with non-null p_parallel and p_perp fields. Non-null density and electron_temperature fields are sampled when present.
inputs.units: mixed; psi retains caller units (Wb/rad for current SciRel free-boundary equilibrium), pressure fields Pa, other profile units as supplied
inputs.dtype: Python mapping with real scalar field array-likes
inputs.constraints: Fields used by a requested branch must be finite and match R and Z under the bound sampler contract; an unused field is not inspected.

inputs.name: R
inputs.description: Radial coordinate mesh for every sampled field.
inputs.constraints: Explicit key required; when sampling, must be finite and rectilinear with a strictly increasing radial axis and at least two columns.

inputs.name: Z
inputs.description: Vertical coordinate mesh for every sampled field.
inputs.constraints: Explicit key required; when sampling, must match R and have a strictly increasing vertical axis with at least two rows.

inputs.name: observations
inputs.description: Request mapping. A flux_loops and/or thomson key requests that branch; each requested mapping must contain non-null points. Other keys are ignored.
inputs.units: point coordinates m,m; any additional request fields are ignored
inputs.shape: mapping with optional flux_loops and thomson mappings, each holding points [N_point,2]
inputs.dtype: Python mapping with real point array-likes
inputs.constraints: Each requested points array is finite and ordered [R,Z] inside the closed grid; an empty or unknown-only mapping returns an empty mapping.

outputs.name: flux_loops
outputs.description: Point samples of equilibrium.psi in requested order, not integrated loop flux; the key is absent when flux_loops is not requested.
outputs.units: same as equilibrium.psi; Wb/rad for current SciRel free-boundary equilibrium, with no automatic 2π conversion
outputs.constraints: Emitted only on a successful flux_loops branch, never as a null placeholder. Physical Wb loop observations require an explicit compatible diagnostic relation before residual comparison.

outputs.name: thomson
outputs.description: Mapping of sampled p_parallel and p_perp and, when present and non-null, density and electron_temperature; the key is absent when thomson is not requested.
outputs.units: p_parallel/p_perp Pa; density and electron_temperature retain caller field units
outputs.shape: mapping of [N_thomson] arrays when requested; otherwise absent
outputs.dtype: mapping of float64 arrays when present
outputs.constraints: Mandatory pressure keys are emitted on success; optional nested profile keys are omitted when their source field is missing or null.

preconditions: The caller has supplied equilibrium fields on the declared [Z,R] grid and has chosen diagnostic requests and in-domain [R,Z] points.
The interpretation and units of optional density and electron_temperature profiles are established by the caller.
supported: Flux-loop-like point sampling of supplied psi without unit conversion.
Thomson-like point sampling of supplied pressure and optional local profile fields.
An empty or unknown-only request mapping yielding no predictions.
excluded: Automatic 2π psi-to-complete-loop-flux conversion, instrument response, line integration, measurement noise, or synthetic spectra.
Equilibrium reconstruction or physical validation of caller-provided state.
Interpolation outside the rectilinear grid or automatic conversion of profile units.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when inputs, equilibrium, or observations is not a mapping; when R or Z is absent; when a requested branch is not a mapping or lacks non-null points; when its required equilibrium field is absent or null; or when the bound sampler rejects its grid, field, or points. An unused optional field is not checked.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: The first dependency error propagates immediately; there is no fallback or retry. Unexpected array conversion or arithmetic failures also propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the graph has no iteration or feedback.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result mapping is returned if a requested branch fails, including failure in thomson after flux_loops has been sampled.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel composition mapped to a saved Pleiades L1 diagnostic TaskGraph and direct graph tests. Historical candidate and admission records are development provenance, not expert recognition of this version.
source_kinds: saved L1 TaskGraph contract and implementation
maintained SciRel graph and sampler regression tests

example.description: Request both branches on a two-by-two R-Z grid, then verify the caller-psi and pressure point samples; the example does not model a physical loop flux.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.diagnostics import synthesize_equilibrium_diagnostics
R, Z = np.meshgrid([0.0, 1.0], [0.0, 1.0])
result = synthesize_equilibrium_diagnostics(R=R, Z=Z, equilibrium={'psi': R + 2.0*Z, 'profiles': {'p_parallel': 10.0 + R + Z, 'p_perp': 20.0 + 2.0*R + Z}}, observations={'flux_loops': {'points': [[0.5, 0.5]]}, 'thomson': {'points': [[0.5, 0.5]]}})
assert list(result) == ['flux_loops', 'thomson']
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['flux_loops'], [1.5])
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['thomson']['p_parallel'], [11.0])
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['thomson']['p_perp'], [21.5])
assert set(result['thomson']) == {'p_parallel', 'p_perp'}
example.expected: Caller-psi point sample [1.5] under the flux_loops key and Thomson-like pressure samples [11.0] and [21.5]; optional profile keys are absent.

scope: Public callable injects the declared sampler dependency.
Flux-only and combined requests preserve flux-before-Thomson output order and point values; a uniform-Bz manufactured psi field confirms the flux_loops channel has no implicit 2π conversion.
Missing optional profile fields and unrequested diagnostic branches are omitted.
Out-of-domain points or missing required state fields raise, and the equilibrium mapping remains unchanged.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Maintained SciRel direct tests establish selected branch, interpolation, failure, and nonmutation behavior on small grids. They do not establish the physical validity of the supplied equilibrium, a real diagnostic instrument model, or expert recognition of this development record.
known_limitations: Despite its historical flux_loops key, the graph returns supplied psi point samples; physical Wb loop observations must not be compared directly with Wb/rad psi from current SciRel equilibrium.
The graph samples supplied fields but does not infer density or temperature from pressure.
Unknown observation keys are silently ignored.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.

execution.ordering: Validate the three required mappings and presence of R and Z; process flux_loops first if requested, then thomson if requested. Within thomson, sample p_parallel, p_perp, optional density, then optional electron_temperature.
branches: A flux_loops key triggers psi sampling; without it, omit flux_loops from the output.
A thomson key triggers mandatory pressure sampling plus each present non-null optional profile; without it, omit thomson from the output.
Empty or unknown-only observations yield an empty mapping, while unknown keys alongside recognized requests are ignored.
execution.state_ownership: The caller retains ownership of equilibrium, observations, grids, and point arrays. The graph owns only a per-call output mapping and per-call sample arrays; it does not mutate the equilibrium state or retain persistent state.
execution.failure_propagation: A missing requested field or dependency failure aborts immediately; no fallback or partial prediction mapping is returned.
